---
title: "Identifying and explaining bias"
---

Residual diagnostics identify areas whose active-user counts differ from the
counts expected under a population-only model. Associations with a covariate
help describe spatial patterns; interpretation requires knowledge of how the
observations and covariates were collected.

```python
from debiaspy import debiaspy_example_data, validate_bias_residual_structure

bundle = debiaspy_example_data(n_areas=25)
result = validate_bias_residual_structure(
    bundle["coverage"],
    covariate_df=bundle["covariates"], covariate_col="rural_pct",
)
print(result["summary"])
```

The result includes area residuals, model summaries and optional correlations.
Supply explicit neighbour links for spatial association, or coordinates for
maps. Review residual magnitude alongside the counts and model assumptions.
